violation_type.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care until Children Released (26 TAC §744.3553(4))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care until Children Released
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not contain information on how the operation will ensure the children are supervised and care will be continued at the relocation area if they can not return to the operation due to an evacuation.

finding_variants.text: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not contain information on how the operation will ensure the children are supervised and care will be continued at the relocation area if they can not return to the operation due to an evacuation.
The emergency preparedness plan did not indicate how staff will continue to care for children until each child has been released.
